name: Chessmasters
service: AI chess game analysis and coaching reports
description: Submit a finished public Chess.com or Lichess game and receive a streaming, plain-English coaching report enriched with Stockfish blunder detection.
inputs: Chess.com username plus game URL (public archive, last 3 months)
outputs: Coaching report: Strength, Weakness, Game Overview, Focus Areas, Resources
Interactive board diagrams of key moments
Focus-area training links (Lichess training themes and studies)
AI Psychological Profile after three analyzed games

pricing.billing: Razorpay; pause, resume, or cancel anytime
